skill_name: Write about the battle of Dunkirk.
workflow: The Battle of Dunkirk was an important conflict during World War II, when Allied Forces were surrounded by Nazi Germany in the north of France. The British Expeditionary Force, aided by French and Belgian soldiers, held off the Germans’ advance while British boats rescued hundreds of thousands of Allied soldiers from the beaches at Dunkirk.
